record.question: The _______ is the owner of the medical record as a matter of property.
record.explanation: Official final key: D — Hospital. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 3, printed Q58. Source limitation: “Owner as a matter of property” is jurisdiction-specific and conflates physical record ownership with patient information/access rights. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
